adobe_api: No dedicated shape route in pinned Photoshop v2 contract. Proprietary shape actionJSON descriptors and editable PSD interchange remain unqualified; no fabricated routes. Existing Adobe route regression coverage remains independent.
limitations: No live desktop qualification while last authoritative desktop state remains locked. Offscreen rendering and synthetic events are not live tests.
Editable PSD shape output remains explicitly unsupported; keep native original or rasterize/flatten an export copy.
Adobe CSH preset import/export and proprietary preset assets not implemented. Native presets work.
Gradient/pattern shape cross-profile document transfer explicitly requires rasterization; solid paints convert.
Compound drawing retains parametric components; multi-layer Combine Shapes menu operations and full vector manipulation remain open.
Path/pixel mode Actions capture remains separately incomplete; native Undo is supported.
Physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 and App Store distribution remain unqualified.
